desc: Derive the greedy characterization: for K pairs, use the K smallest as tops and K largest as bottoms paired in ascending order.
Reformulate feasibility as max D[p] over p in [L,L+K-1] being at most R-L+1-K, where D[p]=F[p]-p and F[p]=first index with A[F[p]] >= 2A[p].
Select a static RMQ plus per-query binary search strategy; O(N log N + Q log N) is acceptable.
Implement the sparse-table RMQ solution in Python with buffered I/O.
Validate implementation on both supplied samples and edge cases (duplicates, no valid pairs, and maximum possible pairs).
